arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
src = open('scratch/report.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
lines = src.split('\n')
out = []
inside = False
for ln in lines:
    if re.match(r'^##\s', ln):
        if inside:
            break
        if ln.strip() == '## 风险':
            inside = True
            continue
    if inside:
        out.append(ln)
text = '\n'.join(out).strip()
open('scratch/risk.txt', 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(text + '\n')
print(repr(text))
EOF
echo "=== after ==="; md5sum scratch/report.md; cat scratch/risk.txt; python3 -c "print(open('scratch/risk.txt','rb').read())"
